instruction: How much did I spend on amazon in this or the last calendar month?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task (no database changes). Current date is 2023-05-18, so the relevant calendar months are April and May 2023. The agent lists orders with amazon.show_orders, then calls amazon.show_order for every order dated in those months to read its total, and reports the sum. Aggregation is modeled without numeric fluents: amount objects form a running-sum chain (spend-0 -> spend-after-order-1 -> spend-after-order-2) and each show_order advances the running spend via the static adds-to-spend facts; the final amount in the chain is the answer. order-1/order-2 are placeholders for however many in-period orders exist (the show_order step is repeated per order; show_orders may need pagination). The username is the supervisor's email; password comes from show_account_passwords. All actions are read-only, satisfying the no-model-changes requirement.
